references.title: DWDS: Gewissen
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: ahd. giwiʒʒanī, an abstract on giwiʒʒan, the old participle of wissen

notes.rationale: ihr schlechtes Gewissen. The ge- belongs to an Old High German participle that left no modern word, so it is a fossilized prefix the affix test doesn't confirm, and it stays inside the Root, as in Geselle. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word: the Root gewissen and the zero ending (ADR 0051).
